eng_en_jr_0194.mp3.text: Attention, everyone! Here is some news about our School Sports Day. It will be held next Friday on the school playground. The relay race will start at nine in the morning, and our class won first prize last year. Please come and cheer for your classmates!

english_gap_llm_011.mp3.text:
Hey, Wang Mei, are you going to the library today?
Yes, I am. I need to borrow some books for our project.
Great! Do you know where the bookshelf for our history books is?
No, I don't. Can you show me the way?
Sure, it's on the second floor. Just take the stairs and go straight. You can't miss it.
Thanks a lot! I really appreciate your help.
No problem, Wang Mei. Let's go together.

english_gap_llm_012.mp3.text:
Listen to the following dialogue about a family's daily routine. Then answer the questions.
Good morning! Today, I'm going to talk about my family's daily routine. Every morning, my parents wake up at 6:00 a.m. They have breakfast together at 7:00 a.m. After that, my father goes to work and my mother stays at home.
What does your mother do at home?
She does some housework and takes care of my little sister. My sister has school at 8:00 a.m., so she leaves for school at 7:45 a.m.
And what about the evening routine?
In the evening, we usually have dinner together at 6:00 p.m. After dinner, my father reads a book, and my mother watches TV. My sister does her homework and then goes to bed at 9:00 p.m.

english_gap_llm_013.mp3.text: Attention, everyone! The school canteen will be closed for maintenance next Friday, June 2nd. The canteen will reopen on June 5th. All students are advised to bring their lunch from home on that day. And remember to keep away from the canteen area to ensure safety.

english_gap_llm_014.mp3.text:
Hello, is this Mr. Smith?
Yes, it is. How can I help you?
Hi, Mr. Smith. This is Tom from the library. We have a book club meeting scheduled for next week. Could we set up a time for the meeting?
Sure, Tom. When would you suggest we meet?
How about Friday afternoon?
That sounds good. What time would be convenient for you?
I'm free from 3:00 to 5:00. How about you?
I'm available during that time. Let's make it 3:30. Can we meet in the conference room?
Perfect. 3:30 in the conference room on Friday. See you then.
See you then, Tom.

english_gap_llm_015.mp3.text:
Hey, John, can you tell us about your favorite sport?
Sure, it's basketball. Why do you ask?
I'm curious about what students like these days.
Well, I've always been interested in playing basketball since I was a kid. It's fast-paced and exciting.
Do you play basketball every day?
Not really. I play a couple of times a week, usually on weekends.
That's great. Where do you play?
I mostly play at the school gym with my friends.
Do you prefer playing with boys or girls?
I don't really have a preference. I enjoy playing with anyone who's up for it.

english_gap_llm_016.mp3.text:
I've always wanted to participate in environmental protection activities. Do you have any suggestions, Wang Mei?
Sure, I think you could join the local community clean-up project. It's great for the environment and a chance to meet new people.
That sounds interesting. What time does it start?
It starts at 8 am and ends at 12 pm. They provide lunch for all the volunteers.
I'm a bit worried about the tasks we have to do.
Don't worry, the tasks are quite simple. You just need to pick up litter and plant some trees.
Okay, I'm ready to help!
Great! Let's meet at the community center at 7:45 am.
